title: Balochistan Local Government Election Third Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Election Third Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

BALOCHISTAN STATUTES
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTION
(THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 9th July, 2001]
No. Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000-III,
dated 9-7-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 5th July, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Local Government
Elections (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 9 of Ordinance VI of 2000

BALOCHISTAN STATUTES
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTION
(THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 9th July, 2001]
No. Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000-III,
dated 9-7-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 5th July, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 9 of
Ordinance VI of 2000.----In the Balochistan Local Government Election
Ordinance, 2000, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance for ,section 9,
the following shall be substituted:--
"9. Special
Minority Seats. -In a union council where the population of minorities is
in excess of ten per cent. of the total population of the union, reserved seats
for minority communities mentioned in the preceding section shall be allocated
in the manner prescribed by the Government."

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Election Third Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 14 of Ordinance VI of 2000

BALOCHISTAN STATUTES
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTION
(THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 9th July, 2001]
No. Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000-III,
dated 9-7-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 5th July, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 14 of
Ordinance VI of 2000.-----In the said Ordinance in section 14,--
(a) the existing section 14,
shall be numbered as subsection (1) of that section and in subsection (1) as so
numbered for clause (s), the following shall be substituted:--
"(s) has not used directly
or indirectly for his election the platform, flag, symbol, affiliation and
financial or material resources or support of a political, religious, ethnic or
sectarian party, formation or organization."
(b) after subsection (1) the
following new subsection shall be added:
(a) is found by the Chief
Election Commissioner to have contravened the provision of subsection (1) shall
stand disqualified from being a candidate for election to a local Government
for a period of four years; or
(b) having been elected as a
member of local Government or being holder of an elective office of local
Government is found by the Chief Election Commissioner to have contravened the
provisions of subsection (1) shall cease forthwith to be an elected member or
to hold the office of such member and stand disqualified from being a candidate,
for election to a local Government for a period of four years".

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Election Third Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 16 of Ordinance VI of 2000

BALOCHISTAN STATUTES
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTION
(THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 9th July, 2001]
No. Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000-III,
dated 9-7-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 5th July, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
5. Amendment of section 16 of
Ordinance VI of 2000.--In the said Ordinance, for subsections (2) and (3)
of section 16, the following shall be substituted:--
"(2) The Nazim and the Naib
Nazim of a District Government or a Town Government or a Tehsil Government
securing as joint candidates more than 50 % of votes shall be declared elected.
(3) In case a Zila Nazim and a
Naib Zila Nazim or a Town Nazim and Naib Town Nazim or a Tehsil Nazim and a
Naib Tehsil Nazim do not secure more than 5010 of the total votes of the
members of the union councils in the district, there shall be held a fresh
election, within one week of the first election, in which the joint candidates
for such offices securing the highest and the second highest number of votes
shall be contestants, and the joint candidates securing the highest number of
votes in the fresh election shall be declared elected.".
